_doc: Check Item Status status-matrix data. Each row is one InventoryStatus partition we probe for live. The probe (cy.iaProbeSerialWithStatus) hits /incoming-items/defective-reports?status=<status> at runtime — we don't pin a specific serial number here because QA data churns. If the probe returns null for a status the test calls this.skip(). Tests are read-only — no state mutation.
